Description:
Al Engineer / Al Agent Developer focused on building and deploying
GenAl agents within the organization's AWS-based Al ecosystem.
The team is specifically looking for candidates with hands-on experience
deploying agents on Amazon Bedrock and Amazon AgentCore, including
understanding how AgentCore manages runtime, memory, policy
engines, identity integration, and agent deployment architecture.
This is a hands-on engineering role requiring candidates to design, build,
deploy, and support Al-powered solutions rather than simply consume or
configure Al tools.
Must Have Skills:
• Experience working with Al/GenAl services such as Amazon Bedrock,
SageMaker, Amazon Q, or similar platforms to support Al-based use
cases.
• Hands-on experience with embeddings, RAG patterns, vector
databases, or similar technologies.
• Experience with AWS data services such as Glue, Athena,
DynamoDB, RDS, Redshift.
• Experience building or supporting data ingestion, transformation,
and orchestration workflows
• Familiarity with CloudWatch, logging, alerting, troubleshooting, and
performance optimization for cloud-based Al/data solutions.

Good-to-Have Skills:
• Understanding of IAM roles/policies, least privilege access,
encryption, secrets management, APl integrations, and secure cloud
design patterns.
• Ability to develop Python scripts, REST APls, serverless functions,
and automation for Al/data workflows.
• Ability to work with architecture, security, data, and application
teams to support POCs, document designs, and drive cloud/Al
solution adoption.
• Understanding of IAM roles/policies, least privilege access,
